d: Copper-orange, chin-length wavy hair with a side-swept fringe, tucked under a brown bowler hat. Deep violet, almond-shaped eyes with a mischievous expression on a youthful, mature face. Slender build wearing a burnt-orange cropped capelet over a white midriff-baring top, a brown pleated mini-skirt with a metallic chain, and sheer black thigh-high stockings with black leather oxfords. Accessories include a silver pocket watch, a brown leather satchel, white gloves, and a dark navy blue folder held in one hand.
